description: A fast, memory-safe, asynchronous web crawler for offensive-security automation — high-performance Rust port of ProjectDiscovery Katana

Protext is a high-performance text layout engine written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. It solves the "Canvas Measurement Problem" by using the browser's native API as the ground truth while offloading complex line-breaking and Unicode logic to a memory-safe, blazing-fast core. Ideal for precision web typography.
